import sys, os, json, utime, hashlib, binascii
import M5
from machine import Pin, mem32
import official_flash
with open(official_flash.__file__, 'rb') as _source_file:
 _driver_bytes = _source_file.read()
assert len(_driver_bytes) == 3639 and binascii.hexlify(hashlib.sha256(_driver_bytes).digest()).decode() == '10546386ee156034c268404e96f4d086b88c52254da1fcd2aa19130ce2f6629f'
key = '_m5_flash_route_be220ff9e64143e8b05cace6aabba755'
phase = 'bootstrap'
route_name = 'ledc73'
pattern = 'roundtrip'
events = []
assert key not in sys.modules, 'state nonce reused'
M5.begin()
M5.Display.setBrightness(255)
M5.Display.fillScreen(0)
flash = official_flash.FlashLightUnit((11, 10))
en = Pin(10)
reg = 0x60004000 + 0x554 + 4 * 10
base = mem32[reg]
assert base & 0x3ff == 256, 'bootstrap GPIO route is unsupported'
st = {'en': en, 'flash': flash, 'reg': reg, 'base': base, 'nonce': 'be220ff9e64143e8b05cace6aabba755'}
sys.modules[key] = st
en.value(1)
utime.sleep_us(2)
en.value(0)
utime.sleep_us(600)
route_raw = mem32[reg]
level = int(en.value())
M5.Display.fillRect(M5.Display.width()//2-4, M5.Display.height()//2-4, 8, 8, 0xFFFFFF if level else 0)
print('FLASHLIGHT_ROUTE_GUEST ' + json.dumps({'nonce': 'be220ff9e64143e8b05cace6aabba755', 'phase': phase, 'route_name': route_name,
 'pattern': pattern, 'en': level, 'route_raw': route_raw, 'route_effective': -1 if route_raw & 512 else route_raw & 511,
 'events': events, 'driver_sha256': '10546386ee156034c268404e96f4d086b88c52254da1fcd2aa19130ce2f6629f'}))
